description: Source code for a PHP class 'ADODB2_mssql' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to handle Microsoft SQL Server database schema operations, including type mapping, SQL generation for altering tables, indexes, and column definitions, as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB2_mssql
classes.description: Class for handling Microsoft SQL Server schema operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types to SQL Server specific types.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL Server data type for a given meta type.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to a table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions, including default, identity, nullability, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or dropping indexes.

methods.name: _GetSize
methods.description: Determines the size and type of SQL Server data types based on input parameters.
